ideas.title: The $250M Minnesota Medicaid Fraud: An Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged $250M Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including connections to shell companies and potential whistleblower retaliation.
questions: Who are the individuals and companies involved?
What is the extent of the alleged fraud?
How did the whistleblowers get involved?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing in Minnesota's Medicaid program. Investigating the connections between providers, shell companies, and whistleblowers may lead to further evidence of fraud and abuse.

ideas.title: The Impact of Data Breaches on Identity Theft
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of recent data breaches on identity theft and cybersecurity.
questions: What is the extent of the data breaches?
How do data breaches lead to identity theft?
What can be done to prevent future breaches?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover the consequences of recent data breaches and highlight the importance of cybersecurity. Investigating the impact on identity theft may lead to further insights into data security.
